subject: GTA:SA zones, radar grid and the map gridref

zone_record.loaded_via: the IPL path; gta.dat lists `IPL DATA\MAP.ZON` and `IPL DATA\INFO.ZON`

map_zon.text_key: UNUSED (a sentinel; hashes to no GXT key)

radar_grid.tier: verified (count, naming, grid arithmetic, tile orientation)

gridref.note: a development ownership table - maps map-grid cells to Rockstar artist user IDs - shipped in retail and still parsed by the engine

consumers.finding: The loader IS called at init, so the 100-record table at 0xC72FB0 is populated. But the four accessor functions (world->cell x2, a validity check, and the getter that returns atoi(name)) have ZERO call/jmp/pointer references anywhere in the executable. The table is WRITE-ONLY in retail: loaded and never read. The consuming feature was cut, leaving the reader API as unreferenced dead code.

gridref.tier: verified (grid, completeness, record size, index arithmetic, consumers)

checks.name: info.zon: every record has exactly 10 fields
map.zon: every record has exactly 10 fields
both files are a single `zone` ... `end` section
info.zon: every bounding box has min < max on all three axes
map.zon: every bounding box has min < max on all three axes
map.zon spans exactly -3000..+3000 on X and Y (the world square)
info.zon lies inside the world square
EVERY info.zon text key resolves to a GXT key (C19 cross-check)
map.zon's text key is the sentinel UNUSED and resolves to nothing
gta3.img holds exactly 144 radarNN.txd tiles, numbered 0..143 with no gap
144 tiles form a 12 x 12 grid over the 6000-unit world
exe world->tile conversion uses +3000, x(1/500) and an 11-row Y-flip
exe conversion opcodes present at VA 0x5858D0 (fadd/fmul/fsubr)
exe tile index is col + row*12  (lea [ecx+ecx*2]; [eax+ecx*4])
tile 0 = NW corner; 11 = NE; 132 = SW; 143 = SE
gridref.dat is a complete 10 x 10 grid (A1..J10)
the exe's index arithmetic maps the 100 cells onto 0..3168 step 32, no collision
gridref table base 0xC72FB0 is written by loader and getter
gridref loader (0x71D4E0) IS called (so the table is populated at init)
the 4 gridref accessor functions are DEAD CODE (zero refs anywhere)
